summary.goal: Build the Ideation layer that transforms raw intent into crystallized understanding ready for formal planning. This is the 'nugget extraction' phase in the gold mining architecture - where human ideas become refined, understood intents with guardian agent observations.
in_scope: Session entity (persisted brainstorm conversations with transcript and understanding)
Understanding as freeform state (map of specialist name -> freeform observations)
REST API for session CRUD and send-to-planner
Send to Planner (create/update plan from session understanding at any time)
out_of_scope: Mode A: Signal-driven ideation (future - requires Intake)
Integration with external channels (Slack, email, GitHub)
Guardian persistence across sessions (v2 - trajectory integration)
constraints: Must use existing tech stack (TypeScript, SQLite, Zod, Relay)
Interviewer follows PlannerLead pattern (persistent RelayClient service)
Must produce output compatible with Planner's freeform understanding schema
Specialists must be able to observe conversation and contribute freeform observations
Intelligence lives in agent prompts, not Zod schemas

acceptance_criteria.description: Session can be created with initial intent and optional initiative_id, persisted to SQLite
Conversation transcript (user + assistant only) is captured and persisted per session
Interviewer facilitates brainstorming via Relay messaging (user never sees specialists)
Specialists are spawned on-demand and add freeform observations to understanding
Understanding is freeform: Record<string, Record<string, unknown>>
Session understanding can be sent to Planner at any time to create/update a Plan
Sessions stay active after sending to Planner (user can continue ideating)
Session status lifecycle: active | abandoned (no crystallized/promoted states)
REST API exposes session CRUD and send-to-planner operations
Mock mode works without Anthropic API key

decisions.decision: No Nugget entity - Understanding is live state
decisions.rationale: Understanding continuously evolves. Sent to planner as snapshot. Simpler model without intermediate crystallization.
User can continue ideating after sending to planner, send again for replanning. No artificial end state.
Specialists NEVER appear in chat or reveal their existence. Interviewer weaves their insights into its own questions.
Intelligence lives in agent prompts, not Zod schemas. Any specialist type, any observation structure.
Interviewer spawns specialists on-demand based on conversation needs, not all at start. More efficient.

decisions.decision: Send to Planner available anytime with confidence indicator
decisions.rationale: Confidence bar (red→orange→green) is advisory, not blocking. Button always enabled.

decisions.decision: Mode B first (human-initiated) with hooks for Mode A

decisions.rationale: Must remain available for conversation continuity, like PlannerLead
Interviewer decides what expertise is needed and spawns appropriate specialists dynamically
Common templates (Architect, Designer, etc.) available but Interviewer can spawn custom specialists
